device.title: Set up WalkingPad
device.description: Power on the WalkingPad, close KS Fit, and select the detected device. The address identifies the WalkingPad and is filled in automatically; manual entry is only a fallback.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.
error.device_not_found: The device is not reachable through a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy. Turn it on and close KS Fit.
error.unsupported_device: This Bluetooth name is not supported.

abort.not_connectable: This scanner cannot establish Bluetooth connections.
